title: ilXyr canonical experiment verdict v1
description: Canonical machine-readable verdict for a completed experiment outcome, including negative/no-go results. Each verdict carries a taxonomy classification so cross-repo negative knowledge becomes queryable at design time.

outcome.description: Canonical verdict label. 'no_go' is a generic negative result. 'complete_no_go' means the hypothesis is definitively rejected. 'measured_local_no_go' means a local/diagnostic measurement failed while mechanics were confirmed. 'execution_failure' is an infrastructure stop before a scientific result.

taxonomy.description: Classification of the negative result. 'transfer': the mechanism failed to generalize to unseen data/ranks/conditions. 'interference': the mechanism conflicted with another frozen gate or objective. 'measurement': the result is a measured boundary or resource frontier. 'venue': the result is a venue/resource limitation (e.g. oracle timeout). 'implementation': the result stems from an implementation or infrastructure defect.

mechanism.description: Human-readable description of the mechanism that was tested, for cross-repo diffing.

mechanism_tags.description: Structured lowercase tags identifying the mechanism family (e.g. 'replay-guard', 'cumulative', 'backtracking', 'gradient-projection', 'shortcut-resistant-routing', 'oracle-frontier'). New experiment SPECs declare their own mechanism_tags; the design-time diff matches these against registered verdicts.

summary.description: One-paragraph prose summary of the verdict and its scientific context.

lineage_note.description: Optional guidance for follow-up experiments — what NOT to repeat and why.

retro_registration_ref.description: If the verdict was imported through the retro lane, the retro-registration spec id.
